purpose: ROOT supplies literal saved stage dispositions and local evidence links. No outcomes, source freeze, actual run or qualification are fabricated by this source schema.

required_view_fields.status_note: String with actual source/experiment status and explicit claim scope.

stages.stage: Saved stage and exact version identity, supplied by ROOT.
stages.scope: source-only / metadata review / actual fixture / context preparation / independent static / proof search / training, as supported by the record.
stages.disposition: Literal saved disposition; unknown and not_run must remain distinct from acceptance.
stages.note: Actual observation, limitations, costs with ownership scope, or missing prerequisite.
stages.evidence_label: Human-readable name of the saved record.
stages.evidence: Relative evidence/ path to an exact copied saved record. No traversal or external URL.

evidence.label: Saved evidence name.
evidence.href: Relative evidence/ path to exact copied saved evidence.

ROOT_assembly_requirements: Assemble actual data and pin every exact copied evidence origin; no draft example is a result.
Supply exact successor source bindings and review dispositions only after ROOT owns those pins. Source filenames alone cannot establish freeze, review, acceptance or execution.

Preserve the original first donor resource UNKNOWN and four remaining unexecuted frozen contexts; all-five qualification stays false unless a separately supported later claim explicitly states its version and scope.
Keep non-scientific calibration and synthetic metadata fixtures separate from actual proof search, semantic context qualification and learning.
The source-only diagram and HTML baseline are not a new experimental milestone. New stage rows require actual saved evidence of their declared scope.
Keep phase clocks, outer ownership, source-only review costs and publication costs labeled separately; missing costs remain unavailable.
Any changed baseline or new theorem/proof/training claim requires a separately reviewed reader successor rather than silently changing the fixed Notebook 115 paragraph.
The two formula panels reproduce existing goals from curriculum-contexts/view.json; they do not specify or disclose a human-authored proof route.
Publish only through ROOT after evidence assembly, independent review and live rendering checks. This draft contains no publication action.
